title: Avoid blocking I/O in async streaming function
description:
_stream_pane_output() at lines 277-290 is an async generator but calls synchronous libtmux operations:

- pane.capture_pane() on line 282 is a blocking call that shells out to tmux
- This blocks the asyncio event loop during each poll cycle

Options:
1. Run capture_pane() in a thread executor: await asyncio.to_thread(pane.capture_pane)
2. Use run_in_executor explicitly for Python <3.9 compatibility
3. Document that the endpoint is not suitable for high-concurrency use

The issue only affects /panes/{target}/stream; other endpoints are sync and unaffected.
